Questions

What exactly triggers an alert?

A change on a source page for a plan or provider you watch, found by our weekly check and confirmed by hand before it is sent: a price move, a new fee, or an intro price that renews.

How fast are alerts?

Within the weekly check cycle, not real-time. We would rather be correct than first.

Is Pro available now?

Pro is in early access: you join now at the listed price and features roll out as they are finished. The free ledger, calculator and comparisons stay free.

Can I cancel?

Yes, cancel anytime; you keep Pro until the end of the period you paid for.

Do you sell my data or rank sponsors higher?

No. Rankings are computed cost only, and your watch list is not shared with providers.
